messages.content: 一根載有2安培電流的電線，距離4米的點的磁場是多少？

message.reasoning:
The user asks: "一根載有2安培電流的電線，距離4米的點的磁場是多少？" In Chinese: "A wire carrying a current of 2 amperes, what is the magnetic field at a point 4 meters away?" They want the magnetic field magnitude due to an infinite straight current-carrying wire at distance r.

Formula: B = μ0 I / (2π r). μ0 = 4π × 10^-7 T·m/A. So B = (4π×10^-7 * I) / (2π r) = (2×10^-7 * I)/r? Wait compute: μ0/(2π) = (4π×10^-7)/(2π) = 2×10^-7. So B = (2×10^-7 * I)/r. With I=2 A, r=4 m: B = (2×10^-7 * 2)/4 = (4×10^-7)/4 = 1×10^-7 T. So answer: 1e-7 Tesla.

We can provide explanation. No tool needed.
